name: GhostFileUploadList
description: Unordered list of chosen files (ul), rendered only while the list is non-empty. Consumers name it with aria-label or aria-labelledby.

slots.name: default
slots.description: GhostFileUploadItem elements, usually one per entry.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: `null` while the list is empty (the list is not rendered).
